manifest.name: MEMORY-µ
manifest.description: Long-term memory micronaut (Xul phase) — save user preferences, session context, and micronaut data; recall by key/category/ngram evidence; forget entries; memory event journal. xcfe_gated for write ops.

memory.save.description: Xul-phase: save user preference, session context, or micronaut data to the memory store. Writes memory event journal entry. xcfe_required for all writes.

memory.recall.description: Pop/Yax-phase: recall memory entries — score_recall_candidates by ngram evidence, fold_ngram_evidence for relevance weighting, verify_key_authority before returning.

memory.forget.description: Xul-phase: mark memory entry as forgotten — writes forget event to journal, removes from recall index. xcfe_required.

memory.journal.description: Pop-phase: read memory event journal — returns chronological log of save/recall/forget events with timestamps and category.

memory.health.description: Pop-phase: reports memory store size by category, journal entry count, recall scoring engine status.
